description: This file defines API routes for managing orders in an e-commerce backend, including creating, searching, fetching, updating, and deleting orders, with associated models and middleware.

methods.name: router.post('/add')
methods.description: Handles creation of a new order, saves it, and sends a confirmation email.

methods.name: router.get('/search')
methods.description: Searches for orders by ID, with role-based access control.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of all orders.

methods.name: router.get('/me')
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of orders for the authenticated user.

methods.name: router.get('/:orderId')
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific order by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/cancel/:orderId')
methods.description: Cancels an order and associated cart, restoring product quantities.

methods.name: router.put('/status/item/:itemId')
methods.description: Updates the status of an individual cart item, possibly cancelling the order if all items are cancelled.
